name: me mostre sonhos doces
source:
"Surely, if I keep taking these, one day I’ll stop having nightmares."

A short game about searching for sweet winter dreams.

[Edited from [url=https://meiri.itch.io/sonhos-doces]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“只要一直吃下去，总有一天，我就不会再做噩梦了吧。”

一个寻找冬日甜梦的短篇游戏。

〔编译自[url=https://meiri.itch.io/sonhos-doces]itch.io[/url]〕
